offending_extra_words: consistent with industry standards by personnel with the requisite skill and experience
if HDI fails to cure within thirty (30) days of notice
reasons: Locked target is preferred, but the inserted conformance warranty is qualified: "conform in all material respects" instead of straight conformance to documentation. Delete "in all material respects".
No 12-month conformance period for software/the Site is stated; only ninety (90) days is given, so the preferred software duration element fails.

The 90-day services element is absent: the professional/workmanlike warranty in clause (1) carries no period measured from performance or completion, and the 90 days runs only from written acceptance of a deliverable.

The remedy set adds "re-performance" and makes refund available only "at HDI's option" after a 30-day cure, which dilutes the preferred repair/replace/refund election beyond what the position requires.

Minimality fails: the insertion carries unnecessary boilerplate ("consistent with industry standards by personnel with the requisite skill and experience") and a remedy/qualifier package broader than needed to complete the preferred level.
Untouched sentences and unrelated terms (mutual authority reps, Globix carve-out) remain effective and no undefined term or dangling mechanic is introduced, so intent is preserved.
